question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

compassionate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cruel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"compassionate"** means someone who feels or shows sympathy and concern for others. (दयालु)

 
 
• **Example:** The compassionate nurse comforted the injured child after the accident.
 
 
 
• **"Cruel"** refers to someone who causes pain or suffering intentionally and lacks empathy or mercy. (क्रूर)
 
 
• **Example:** The cruel king punished his subjects without any reason.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'compassionate'** is **'cruel'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cruel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confident** (आत्मविश्वासी): Feeling or showing certainty about something or oneself.

 
 
• **Example:** She was confident about her ability to ace the exam.
 
 
 
• **Hardworking** (मेहनती): Putting consistent effort and dedication into tasks or goals.
 
 
• **Example:** His hardworking nature earned him a promotion.
 
 
 
• **Disciplined** (अनुशासित): Showing controlled behavior or adhering to rules and guidelines.
 
 
• **Example:** A disciplined routine helped her achieve her fitness goals.
 
 

3c:Tba5,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**,
